items.question: A 1000 car parking lot is divided into 3 sections. There are 320 spaces in section 1, and 200 more in section 2 than in section 3. How many spaces are made available in section 2 of the parking lot?

previous_f3_program: collection("parking_lot.sections", "section", "parking_lot", source("parking lot is divided into 3 sections"))
observe(at("parking_lot.spaces.count", "current"), 1000, "count", source("A 1000 car parking lot"))
observe(at("parking_lot.sections.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("3 sections"))
partition("parking_lot.sections", at("parking_lot.spaces.count", "current"), source("parking lot is divided into 3 sections"))
observe(at("parking_lot.section_1.spaces.count", "current"), 320, "count", source("320 spaces in section 1"))
offset(at("parking_lot.section_2.spaces.count", "current"), at("parking_lot.section_3.spaces.count", "current"), 200, "count", source("200 more in section 2 than in section 3"))
query("value", at("parking_lot.section_2.spaces.count", "current"))

items.question: The cost of building a certain house in an area is 100,000 more than the construction cost of each of the houses in the area.  But it sells for 1.5 times as much as the other houses, which sell at $320,000 each. How much more profit is made by spending the extra money to build?

previous_f3_program: collection("area.other_houses", "house", "area", source("houses in the area"))

offset(at("area.certain_house.construction_cost", "current"), at("area.other_houses.construction_cost_per_house", "current"), 100000, "currency", source("The cost of building a certain house in an area is 100,000 more than the construction cost of each of the houses in the area"))
multiple(at("area.certain_house.sale_price", "current"), at("area.other_houses.sale_price_per_house", "current"), 1.5, source("it sells for 1.5 times as much as the other houses"))
observe(at("area.other_houses.sale_price_per_house", "current"), 320000, "dollar", source("which sell at $320,000 each"))
query("difference", at("area.other_houses.profit_per_house", "current"), at("area.certain_house.profit", "current"))

items.question: Randy has some money in his piggy bank. He spends 2 dollars every time he goes to the store. He makes 4 trips to the store every month. If he had $104 dollars left in his piggy bank after a year, how much money, in dollars, did he have at first?
What is the average number of nonvested shares granted on January 1, 2017 and between December 30, 2018 and December 29, 2019?

previous_f3_program: observe(at("company.rsus_prsus.nonvested_shares", "January 1, 2017"), 98, "thousand_shares", cell("Nonvested at January 1, 2017", "Number of Shares"))
observe(at("company.rsus_prsus.granted_shares", "between December 30, 2018 and December 29, 2019"), 353, "thousand_shares", cell("Granted", "Number of Shares"))
query("mean", at("company.rsus_prsus.nonvested_shares", "January 1, 2017"), at("company.rsus_prsus.granted_shares", "between December 30, 2018 and December 29, 2019"))

items.question: Tina is getting $20 for each book she sells. If she realizes a $120 profit on her sales, how many people have she sold the books to if each book costs $5 to make and every customer buys 2 at a time?

previous_f3_program: observe(at("tina.sales.books.revenue_per_book", "current"), 20, "currency", source("$20 for each book she sells"))
observe(at("tina.sales.profit", "current"), 120, "currency", source("$120 profit on her sales"))
observe(at("tina.sales.books.production_cost_per_book", "current"), 5, "currency", source("each book costs $5 to make"))
multiple(at("tina.sales.books.count", "current"), at("tina.sales.customers.count", "current"), 2, source("every customer buys 2 at a time"))
query("value", at("tina.sales.customers.count", "current"))
